children.name: Evidence
children.value: The 5 SBR headers and 34 SBR payloads have the layout FAAC 2.x writes: headers that send bs_header_extra_1 and not bs_header_extra_2, with start frequency 15, crossover band 0, bs_noise_bands 0 (one noise floor band) and stop frequency 10, and data that codes every envelope and noise floor across frequency, with no coupling, sinusoids or extended data

children.name: Evidence
children.value: The version comes from the MP4 ©too atom at 0x14C3, which names "FAAC 2.0.0" as the writer: software of the same name

children.name: Bandwidth
children.value: highest coded band ends at about 11025 Hz (max_sfb 47)

findings.message: The moov box follows the mdat box, so a player must read to the end of the file before it can play it (not optimized for streaming, no fast start).
The mdhd box of track 1 gives a duration of 66150 (1.500 s), but its samples' durations in stts add up to 69632 (1.579 s).
